page.title: Import students
page.subtitle: Bring your existing student list in from a CSV or Excel file. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

upload.title: Choose your file
upload.body: Use a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file with one student per row and a heading row. Up to {rows, number} students and {mb} MB.
upload.required: Each student needs a name and a Sri Lankan mobile number. Everything else is optional.
upload.tips: Name, phone, student number, school, A/L year, medium, under 18, consent given by, guardian name, relation and phone, and classes (separate several with a semicolon, for example “Physics Theory; Chemistry”).
upload.loaded: {name}: {rows, plural, one {# student row} other {# student rows}} and {columns, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}.

errors.tooLarge: This file is bigger than {mb} MB. Split it into smaller files and import them one at a time.
errors.unsupported: We can read CSV and Excel (.xlsx) files. Save the sheet as one of those and choose it again.
errors.unreadable: We couldn't read this file. Make sure it isn't damaged or password-protected, then try again.
errors.empty: The file has no students in it. It needs a heading row and at least one student row.
errors.tooManyRows: A single import can have up to {rows, number} students. Split the file and import it in parts.

map.title: Match your columns
map.body: Tell us which column of your file holds each detail. We matched what we could from your headings; check them and fix anything that's off.
map.requiredError: Choose the column that holds this.
map.sharedError: This column is already used for another detail.
map.sampleCaption: First rows of your file, as we read them
map.shared: Each column can be used for only one detail. Check {fields}.

hints.phone: A Sri Lankan mobile, for example 077 123 4567. This is how the student signs in.
hints.studentNo: Kept if it isn't used yet. Leave it out and we number students for you.
hints.under18: Yes or no. Students under 18 need “consent given by”.
hints.consentGivenBy: Who gave parental consent, for students under 18.
hints.classes: Names of existing classes, separated by a semicolon.

review.title: Check before you import
review.checking: Checking {count, plural, one {# student} other {# students}}…
review.intro: This is only a check; nothing has been saved. Rows that need a fix or that already exist are left out of the import. Download them, correct them and import that file again.
review.allGood: Everything in your file is ready to import.
review.noneReady: None of the students can be imported yet. Fix the problems below, or choose a different file.
review.tableCaption: Rows of your file and their check result
review.filterProblems: Show only rows that need attention
review.duplicateOfStudent: This phone number already belongs to {studentNo}.
review.duplicateOfStudentAnon: This phone number already belongs to a person at your institute.
review.duplicateOfRow: This phone number is already used in row {row}.
review.welcomeSms: Send each new student a text to set their password
review.welcomeSmsHint: Each text costs SMS credit. You can also send them later from the student's page.
review.enrolFromHint: The first month the fee is charged for the classes in your file.
review.import: Import {count, plural, one {# student} other {# students}}

running.title: Importing your students
running.body: Importing {count, plural, one {# student} other {# students}}. This usually takes a few seconds. Please keep this page open.
running.label: Import in progress
running.slow: This is taking longer than usual. It will keep going in the background; you can check the Students list shortly.

done.title: Import finished
done.created: {count, plural, =0 {No students were imported.} one {# student imported.} other {# students imported.}}
done.enrolled: {count, plural, =0 {} one {# class enrolment added.} other {# class enrolments added.}}
done.skipped: {count, plural, one {# row was left out.} other {# rows were left out.}} Download them, correct them and import that file again.
done.failedBody: Nothing was added to your students. Please try again; if it keeps happening, contact support.

errors.forbidden: Your role isn't allowed to import students, or you've been signed out.
errors.conflict: That conflicts with something that already exists.
errors.validation: Some details in the file aren't valid. Check the file and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many imports. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
